units.source_text: 总之，这条沿着山涧的小路一直延伸到公路，而最受益的就是温泉旅馆。

en.t: In short, this little path along the mountain stream extended all the way to the main road, and the hot spring inn benefited most from it.

units.source_text: 然而，村里一流的旅馆却断然拒绝分摊修路费。

en.t: However, the village's first-class inn flatly refused to share the road repair costs.
